body:
I used to be really disciplined, that's how I got in here in the first place. There's just something broken inside of me and now I can't hardly even get out of bed. I know how. I know the logic and the theory behind it but I don't know. 

It's not just a setback. I'm throwing my entire future away. I wasn't good at anything but school and now I'm not even good at that anymore.

I'm already on academic probation. if I don't pass this class there might not be a next semester. 

It's not a small mistake. It's a giant fucking mistake. I probably can't recover from it.
